description:
This is something I have heard over and over and over again and didn’t really paid that much attention to it, but this is really one of the most important things.

Your attitude is what makes people lean in and listen to you. If you want people to be interested in something - you should be so interested in it that your enthusiasm would be contagious so people would want it before they understand why do they need it.

By the way, I teach people how to work with your state and show up when you don’t feel like that. DM me if you want to work with me personally or just feel free to follow along for more tips
